description:
List the 13 server-side simulation job types with their tool names, parameters, file rules, free-lane bounds and time budgets.
Inputs: none.
Example: {}
Returns: count; the tier allowances; what runs without a key; how long a result link lives; the duplicate-submission window; and for each job type its simulate_* tool name, jobType, title, parameter names, time budget, file rules and free-lane bounds.
Free tier: 5 runs/month. Pro: 100/month. API tier: 10 000/month. A job runs without a key on the free lane; a job that takes a file does not. Uploading a file needs an API key; set RFTOOLS_API_KEY.
name: list_simulation_tools
title: List Simulation Tools
